headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and steady dividend payouts.
summary: Revenue rose across most majors, with TCS at ₹73,188 cr and a 15.4% YoY increase. AI sales were highlighted by HCLTech, LTM and Wipro as key growth drivers. Several companies announced higher interim dividends. Results are still pending for Infosys, OFSS and a few peers.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue contributions rose sharply at HCLTech, LTM and Wipro, supporting higher margins.

themes.title: Dividend strength
themes.detail: TCS, LTM and Tech Mahindra increased interim dividends, reflecting cash generation.

leaders.why: 21.2% YoY revenue growth, the highest among companies with released results.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 20% YoY but net profit fell 25.4% YoY, indicating margin pressure.
